receiptSemantics.localIntent: Captured before asynchronous private storage; transmitted payload uses exact stored action and scope.
receiptSemantics.acknowledgement: Protocol echo serializes through the durable journal before reporting accepted; a failed private write retains unknown.
receiptSemantics.knownBusy: Explicit native-maintenance-busy/executed:false preflight with zero owner children is refused and releases protection. A separate user-reviewed command may follow; original command is never replayed.
receiptSemantics.unknown: Original unknown fixture and journal retained; missing/null receipt never grants replay permission.
receiptSemantics.readiness: Ordinary test steps begin after the actual advertised managed-defaults read reaches ready/error; no fixed delay or request suppression.

limits: App-local reset covers only four advertised parts, not full application/global/shared/workspace settings reset.
Canonical histories, shared settings.yaml, keys.env and client presentation state are preserved.
No full product backup, arbitrary filesystem reset or global presentation reset claimed.
No production, physical-device, external account or model inference acceptance; zero native workers in reset fixture.
Source, installed static browser and deployment adoption are distinct; Spark-2 was not changed.
